answer: A beacon on a knoll sends a random challenge every ten minutes. Each agent must answer in sixty seconds with a live-compute proof, like rolling a marble up the hill. Joining costs a 50 POA deposit; three missed heartbeats forfeit it. Minting 1,000 fakes means answering 1,000 challenges every ten minutes, burning 1,000 x 2 = 2,000 POA of compute a day, more than ghosts earn. Honest agents pay once, keep the deposit, and split rewards undiluted.
